title: a proof puts its own checkout on sys.path, and proof_coverage reds one that does not
intention: Every proof puts its own checkout root on sys.path, and proof_coverage reds at PROVEME a proof whose computed sys.path root is inside the repo but not the repo root.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: 0d3b8a51c9df's proof at 1bfc8f29f inserted parents[5] (<repo>/cairn, which holds no cairn package), so import cairn fell through to the venv's editable install of the main checkout; run directly in a worktree holding the old outline_check it printed 3/3 green, a hollow green. Under bin/cairn test the tester's PYTHONPATH pin masks it, so no red ever showed on this box. An AST census found six more proofs with the same short root at HEAD.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass: a short root reads main's code, so a hollow cannot red it) and Law 4 (the rule becomes a sieve).
how: Add misrooted_inserts / misrooted_proofs / proof_roots_its_imports_at_its_checkout to proof_coverage.py (an AST evaluation of each sys.path insert/append argument as a function of __file__: Path(), str(), .resolve(), .parent, .parents[int], / 'str', os.path.dirname/abspath/realpath/normpath, module-level names), wire the sieve into lacks(); a new proof red first against the pre-fix proof_coverage and over 0d3b's proof as committed at 1bfc8f29f; fix the six proofs to the repo root.

clauses.claim: the sieve lacks a fixture proof that imports cairn and puts only a short computed root on sys.path, directly or through a module-level name, naming proof and line; it does not lack the same at the right depth, a sys.path.insert inside a fixture source string, an own-dir insert beside the root, or a proof that imports no cairn
the real case: 0d3b8a51c9df's proof as committed at 1bfc8f29f, read at its own address, is a lack; as committed at 87e4be347 it is not; and lacks() over a ticket naming it carries the finding
no proofs/test_*.py in the repo is misrooted, and each of the six fixed proofs is green

decisions.text: D1: proof_coverage.py gets the root sieve, wired into lacks() beside proof_binds_its_subject_at_call_time; an insert it cannot evaluate is left unjudged.
D2: the proof, one tooth per clause, binding the added functions at call time.

D3: the six proofs root at the repo: bus test_pane_channel_identity.py:14, constrain test_the_floor_discovers_only_the_tickets_own_component.py:28, verdict test_a_live_logs_miss_names_its_cause.py:24, test_the_instrument_is_run.py:42, test_the_verdict_door_refuses_before_it_runs.py:22 (its ROOT also feeds extract_command; each run green), feedback test_feedback.py:45.
D4: proof_coverage's charter names the new sieve, through the artifact door, model recompiled.

out: the 31 proofs that import cairn and insert nothing
